verdict.rationale: Authy is an authenticator app, so bulk import from other authenticators is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no import feature. The only enrollment path shown is capturing 2FA QR codes one service at a time, which is exactly the per-account re-enrollment the story wants to avoid. Community comments about export difficulty concern migrating off Authy, not importing into it, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
